tea_repo.title: TheoremExplainAgent (TEA): agentic Manim pipeline (local clone)
tea_repo.sha_source: no .git directory in the local copy (discover_repo.py git_head() -> sha None); README News says generation + evaluation code released 2025 Mar 3; files dated 2025-07-26
tea_repo.anchor_convention: src/core/code_generator.py:L337-L390  (repo-relative path, 1-based inclusive line range); README anchors use the full external/TheoremExplainAgent-main/README.md:L<n> form so the checker does not resolve them to cs336_enrich/README.md
tea_repo.note: Line anchors refer to this local copy. discover_repo.py records a sha256 per module in discovered.json so anchors can be re-verified against a fresh clone. Prompt templates are anchored into task_generator/prompts_raw/__init__.py and eval_suite/prompts_raw/__init__.py (the generated Python constants), never into the raw .txt files, because that is what the code imports.

tea_readme.title: README.md: TheoremExplainAgent (TEA)
tea_readme.note: Installation, CLI usage, evaluation usage, how to rebuild prompts (parse_prompt.py), TheoremExplainBench dataset info, FAQ. Anchors are external/TheoremExplainAgent-main/README.md:L<n> (full form, see tea_repo.anchor_convention).
